**Implementation note:** VIX/VIX3M term structure as a data-only regime input (a gap-analysis lead); trading VIX futures is out of scope.

## Description

Trade VIX futures exposure based on contango/backwardation, often with explicit equity-futures hedges or exposure limits.

## Where it may fit

Regimes with persistent term-structure patterns; needs special handling around volatility spikes.

## Vehicles

Volatility funds/ETPs, tactical overlays, specialized hedge funds.

## Required data

VIX futures curve, spot VIX, contract settlements/rolls, equity index futures, margin and costs.

## Caveats

Volatility ETPs have path-dependent roll behavior; a curve signal can suffer abrupt losses in shocks.
